deep_dive.title: Distributed Geometric Optimization and Control of Rigid Differential-Drive Formations from Relative-Position Measurements
deep_dive.authors_text: Thanacha Choopojcharoen, Erman Selim, Ramisha Anjum, Baris Fidan
deep_dive.abstract: Distance based formation control fixes the shape of a robot team but leaves its position and orientation unconstrained. We regulate all three for differential drive robots that have only one absolute position anchor, absolute headings, body frame relative position measurements, and communication with their neighbors. We derive a two layer estimation control scheme directly from optimization. The first half of the result is a set of graph-proximal estimators that reconstruct the centroid, the anchor vector, and the centered coordinates. Exact proximal updates reach consensus in finitely many steps, and a finite number of primal dual iterations leaves a bounded reconstruction error. The controller combines proximal centroid and orientation steps with distance gradient shape regulation, and a finite rotation removes the orientation drift caused by the shape step. A discrete Lyapunov analysis gives local exponential convergence once the estimators have converged. We validate the method in ROS 2 Gazebo and in experiments with five physical robots.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper develops a distributed optimization-based estimation–control scheme that reconstructs formation centroid, anchor vector, and centered coordinates from relative-position measurements and then regulates the shape, centroid, and orientation of differential-drive robot formations with only one absolute-position anchor, validated in ROS 2/Gazebo and with five physical robots.

detailed_reading.motivation: 基于距离的编队控制只能固定机器人团队的形状，无法约束其平面位置与朝向；当多数机器人缺乏全局定位时，需要仅依赖单个绝对位置锚点、绝对航向、机体坐标系相对位置测量和邻居通信，同时调节差速驱动机器人编队的形状、质心与朝向这三个刚体自由度。
detailed_reading.method: 论文针对N≥3台差速驱动机器人引入前视受控点z_i=p_i+ℓq_i，将非完整约束下的控制问题转化为采样受控点增量模型；每个采样周期运行两层算法。重建层用图近端估计器分别重构质心、锚点向量和中心化坐标，先按自身已施加运动预测，再通过邻居间近端/原始-对偶迭代在不改变平均值的约束下达成一致；控制层将近端质心与朝向更新同距离梯度形状调节结合，并用有限旋转消除形状步引入的朝向漂移。底层通过零阶保持下受控点增量的逐机器人逆映射实现差速驱动执行，估计收敛后由离散Lyapunov分析保证局部指数收敛。
detailed_reading.result: 精确近端更新可在有限步内达到一致，有限轮原始-对偶迭代使重建误差有显式上界；在估计器收敛后，闭环对形状、质心跟踪和锚点向量定义的编队朝向具有局部指数收敛性。ROS 2/Gazebo仿真与五台实体机器人实验验证了方法，最终参考周期内质心误差低于1.1 cm、朝向误差低于0.019 rad。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 该工作表明，可以从优化结构直接推导出分布式采样估计—控制架构，在仅有一个绝对位置锚点和局部相对位置测量的条件下同时锁定差速驱动刚体编队的形状、平移与旋转自由度。仿真和硬件实验支持该方案在稀疏通信与局部计算约束下的可实现性和精度。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键假设是通信图连通、距离约束图在期望平面构型附近无穷小刚性，且仅锚点N已知自身绝对受控点位置，锚点主要进入初始化；绝对航向用于把机体相对测量转到共同惯性方向。优化核心是带L-二次项与关联矩阵ℓ2,1精确惩罚的近端目标，需满足μ=β√λ2(L)−Δ>0以保证零分歧唯一最优，并用原始-对偶有限轮迭代近似求解。实现上估计仅需邻居消息，控制增量经零阶保持映射在(0,0)附近雅可比T_s diag(1,ℓ)非奇异而可局部精确实现；局限包括收敛性为估计器收敛后的局部结果、有限轮原始-对偶带来有界重建误差、精确执行依赖足够小增量，以及需要绝对航向、单锚点和刚性连通图等条件。

deep_dive.title: Teaching Agents the "Principle", Not the "Reward"
deep_dive.abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved strong performance in many tasks by letting agents learn from nothing more than a reward signal. However, in more complex tasks, agents still struggle to learn good, generalizable policies, even with carefully designed rewards and abundant samples. We argue that this difficulty stems from the reward decoding burden: designers encode their knowledge of the desired behavior into rewards and penalties, and agents must infer this knowledge from long sequences of noisy scalars. To address this burden, we propose prescriptive policy learning (PPL), which directly teaches agents higher-level knowledge about the tasks, termed principles of behavior, such as how to maintain balance, how to accumulate energy, and how to land smoothly. Through appropriately selected key quantities and references, PPL can directly indicate at every step whether the agent follows the principles and to what extent. Our experiments show that agents can learn good, generalizable policies without any reward. Taught only simple heuristic principles, PPL agents outperform reward-based methods with far fewer samples. Their policies also transfer directly to harder settings and keep performing well, demonstrating their strong generalization ability. In summary, PPL provides a new approach in which rough knowledge of the desired behavior is enough for agents to learn good, generalizable policies, even when the system dynamics cannot be accurately modeled.
deep_dive.tldr: The paper proposes prescriptive policy learning (PPL), which teaches agents higher-level behavioral principles via stepwise key quantities and references instead of reward signals, enabling better, more generalizable policies with fewer samples and no reward.

detailed_reading.motivation: 强化学习依赖奖励信号，但复杂任务中设计者需把行为知识编码为奖励和惩罚，智能体再从长序列含噪标量中反推意图，形成沉重的奖励解码负担，导致策略难以学习且泛化不足。
detailed_reading.method: 提出规定性策略学习（PPL），用人工选定的关键量及其参考值/期望区间构造行为原则，并在每一步评估智能体是否遵循原则及遵循程度，将该原则遵循度直接作为策略学习信号；训练时智能体与环境交互采样并据此更新策略，无需奖励函数，推理时直接执行学得策略。
detailed_reading.result: 实验表明，仅用简单启发式原则、完全不使用奖励，PPL智能体就能以远少于奖励基线的样本学到较好策略，并超过奖励基线的表现；其策略还能直接迁移到更难设置并保持良好性能，显示出强泛化能力。
detailed_reading.conclusion: PPL将教学重点从设计奖励转向直接传授行为原则，说明即使系统动力学无法精确建模，粗略的期望行为知识也足以让智能体学习良好且可泛化的策略，为复杂任务提供了一条不依赖奖励的新路径。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键先验是用少量关键量和参考值表达行为原则，如保持平衡、积累能量、平滑着陆，并在每步计算遵循程度；方法不依赖奖励塑形，原则可较粗略，适用于动力学难精确建模的场景；具体损失、超参和复杂度摘要未披露，且原则与关键量的选择仍需人工设计，可能构成应用局限。

deep_dive.title: Finite-Time Convergence and Regret Guarantees for Neural Reinforcement Learning in POMDPs
deep_dive.authors_text: Jingjuan Huang, Zhiyao Zhang, Alvaro Velasquez, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Jia Liu
deep_dive.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) is computationally challenging due to the curse of long-range dependence on history. Fortunately, recent studies have shown that a range of POMDPs that satisfy the filter stability assumption can be well approximated by a superstate Markov Decision Process (MDP) based on a truncated history in a finite-memory window, with a value gap that decays with the window length. However, existing finite-time convergence analyses on such superstate MDP surrogates are either limited to over-simplified linear function approximation or rely on an i.i.d. sampling oracle that is violated by POMDP trajectories, both of which severely limit the applicability of these theoretical results in practice. This motivates us to bridge the gap by investigating RL in POMDPs with nonlinear neural value function approximation. Our main contributions are threefold: i) We first establish a new finite-state MDP point-wise approximation error bound, which lays the foundation for our RL algorithm design and analysis in POMDPs; ii) By applying Temporal-Difference (TD) learning to POMDP-generated superstate transitions and targeting the Bellman fixed point of the superstate MDP, we prove a finite-time critic error bound with nonlinear neural value function approximation; and iii) By combining the neural critic function approximation error bound with the policy mirror descent framework, we obtain a finite-time sublinear regret against the optimal POMDP value. To the best of our knowledge, such a finite-time sublinear regret based on neural function approximation is the first in the literature for finite-memory POMDPs. Our numerical experiments also verify our theoretical results.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper proves finite-time critic convergence and sublinear regret for neural reinforcement learning in POMDPs by approximating them with finite-memory superstate MDPs and combining neural TD learning with policy mirror descent.

detailed_reading.motivation: POMDP 中策略依赖长历史导致计算困难，有限记忆窗口的超状态 MDP 可在滤波稳定性假设下近似原 POMDP，但已有有限时间分析要么局限于线性函数逼近，要么依赖与实际 POMDP 轨迹不符的独立同分布采样。作者因此研究带非线性神经网络值函数逼近的 POMDP 强化学习，以弥补超状态代理 MDP 在理论分析与实际 on-policy 轨迹采样之间的缺口。
detailed_reading.method: 论文先将满足滤波稳定性假设的 POMDP 历史截断为有限记忆窗口并构造超状态 MDP，建立 POMDP 与超状态 MDP 之间的逐点值函数近似界，并说明奖励函数与转移核失配可由同一滤波稳定性误差控制。随后在由 POMDP 轨迹生成的超状态转移上使用时序差分学习训练非线性神经网络评论家，目标是逼近超状态 MDP 的 Bellman 不动点；通过新的 Lyapunov 下降分析分离轨迹采样误差、神经网络模型误差和部分可观测误差。最后将神经评论家误差界嵌入策略镜像下降框架进行策略迭代，并利用 concentrability 假设处理策略迭代间的非平稳分布偏移，推理流程为采样 POMDP 轨迹、构造超状态、TD 更新神经评论家、PMD 更新策略并累积遗憾。
detailed_reading.result: 论文给出超状态 MDP 的逐点近似误差界，其值差距随有限记忆窗口长度呈 O((1-rho)^ell) 衰减；并证明在 POMDP 轨迹采样下神经评论家可在有限时间内以 epsilon_critic 量级的误差逼近超状态 MDP 的 Bellman 不动点。进一步结合 PMD 得到相对于最优 POMDP 值的有限时间次线性遗憾，且遗憾界显式分离神经评论家误差、有限记忆近似误差和策略优化误差；据作者所知，这是有限记忆 POMDP 中首个基于神经函数逼近的有限时间次线性遗憾结果，数值实验也验证了理论结论。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 在滤波稳定性和 concentrability 等条件下，使用有限记忆超状态代理、神经 TD 评论家和 PMD 策略更新的 POMDP 强化学习算法能够获得有限时间收敛与次线性遗憾保证。该结果将超状态 MDP 近似、非独立同分布 POMDP 轨迹下的神经评论家分析和策略镜像下降统一起来，说明有限记忆窗口与神经网络逼近可在理论上有控地用于部分可观测强化学习。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现点包括：POMDP 具有有限状态、观测和动作空间，奖励有界且折扣因子在 0 到 1 之间；核心先验是滤波稳定性，记忆窗口长度 ell 控制 POMDP 到超状态 MDP 的近似误差；评论家使用非线性神经值函数而非线性模型，并在 POMDP 生成的超状态转移上做 TD 学习，不假设独立同分布采样；分析使用 Lyapunov 下降分解误差，并用 concentrability 假设连接不同策略访问分布；局限是理论依赖滤波稳定性、concentrability、有限状态空间和有限记忆设定，预印本摘要与正文预览未给出具体网络宽度深度、步长、样本复杂度常数和实验超参数。

deep_dive.title: Stochastic Dynamics of Generative AI: From Autoregressive Models to Interacting LLM Networks and Neural SDEs
deep_dive.authors_text: Vikram Krishnamurthy, Yiming Zhang, Luke Snow
deep_dive.abstract: This paper develops a stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on three classes of generative AI models. First, we formulate large language models (LLMs) as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies. This formulation connects pretraining by conditional maximum likelihood to sequential token generation and provides a probabilistic interpretation of LLM operation. Second, we consider networks of interacting LLMs and characterize their collective behavior through mean-field ordinary differential equations. These dynamics provide a framework for understanding emergent preferential attachment and persistent structural biases, including type-dependent glass-ceiling effects. Third, we consider neural stochastic differential equations (SDEs) as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories, including those observed at irregular time intervals. We discuss their training with particular emphasis on Wiener-space cubature methods based on rough-path analysis as an efficient alternative to Monte Carlo estimation. Together, the three settings address probabilistic prediction, information exchange and emergent behavior in interacting networks, and path-space generative modeling.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper presents a unified stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on generative AI, modeling LLMs as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models, analyzing networks of interacting LLMs via mean-field ODEs that reveal emergent structural biases such as glass-ceiling effects, and treating neural SDEs as continuous-time path-space generative models trained efficiently using Wiener-space cubature instead of Monte Carlo estimation.

detailed_reading.motivation: 论文旨在用随机动力系统视角统一理解生成式AI，因为LLM、交互LLM网络和神经SDE虽在状态空间、交互机制与时间尺度上不同，却共享由学习到的非线性函数驱动的随机演化。其关注概率预测、网络信息交换与涌现偏差、路径空间生成建模，并强调机制而非广泛文献综述。
detailed_reading.method: 论文分三部分：将LLM表述为上下文窗口Δ的高维非线性自回归模型，词嵌入经L层因果自注意力与前馈网络得到隐藏态，输出层经softmax和温度τ采样下一token，预训练用条件最大似然估计参数；将多个LLM视为耦合非线性AR系统，在大网络极限下用平均场ODE刻画集体演化并分析平衡与稳定性；将神经SDE用神经网络参数化漂移和扩散以生成连续时间及不规则采样轨迹，训练时采用基于rough-path分析的Wiener空间cubature，以有限条确定性布朗路径及权重替代Monte Carlo期望。
detailed_reading.result: 核心发现有三点：LLM的条件最大似然预训练与自回归token采样形成统一概率解释，注意力机制表现为隐藏态双线性打分、softmax加权和线性聚合；交互LLM的平均场动力学可产生优先连接和持续结构偏差，包括类型相关的玻璃天花板效应；Wiener空间cubature训练神经SDE可将RMSE从Monte Carlo的O(n^{-1/2})改善到O(n^{-1})。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 三类模型可统一为学习非线性函数驱动的随机动力系统，分别对应token级概率预测、交互网络中的涌现结构与偏差、以及路径空间生成建模。该视角为理解LLM生成机制、网络结构性偏差和高效神经SDE训练提供了统一框架。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键细节包括词汇表约十万级BPE token、上下文窗口可达10^6、隐藏维约10^3至10^4，因果掩码使雅可比呈带宽Δ的块下三角结构；采样温度τ控制下一token分布，预训练最大化观测序列条件似然，对齐阶段再调整分布；平均场结论依赖大网络极限和类型依赖交互假设，并需分析ODE平衡与稳定性；神经SDE的cubature轨迹与权重用于匹配迭代Brown积分矩，适合不规则采样，但论文是选择性教程，侧重数学抽象且未做广泛文献综述。

deep_dive.title: Noether's Second Theorem and the Pareto Front Structure in Multi-Criteria Variational Problems
deep_dive.abstract: This paper establishes a rigorous connection between Noether's second theorem and the structure of Pareto fronts in multi-criteria variational problems. We prove that for a family of functionals invariant under a common gauge Lie group, the regular part of the Pareto front is contained in the union of solutions to weighted Euler--Lagrange equations, and that on Pareto-optimal sections, combinations of Noether currents are conserved. Gauge symmetries are shown to impose additional constraints on the Lagrange multipliers via Bianchi-type identities, reducing the dimension of the admissible weight space. Two practical approaches are derived from this result: dimensionality reduction via gauge fixing and scalarization with penalty terms. The theory is validated on three classical problems: the linear-quadratic regulator with two criteria, a model predictive control problem with a minimax criterion, and the double integrator with control constraints. In each case, the Pareto front is shown to satisfy an exact conservation law, and the analytical structure of the front is recovered from the symmetries of the problem. The results demonstrate that gauge functions (null Lagrangians) can restore invariants even when the dynamics break the symmetry, and that control constraints do not destroy the underlying conservation laws but merely restrict the admissible set. The proposed approach yields a Pareto front with minimal deviation from the theoretical curve, outperforming known multi-objective algorithms, and provides a new foundation for the analytical treatment of multi-criteria optimization in nonlinear dynamics and control.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper proves that Noether’s second theorem connects gauge symmetries in multi-criteria variational problems to Bianchi-type constraints on Pareto weights and conserved Noether-current combinations, enabling analytical characterization and dimensionality reduction of Pareto fronts in optimal control.

detailed_reading.motivation: 多准则变分与最优控制中的Pareto前沿通常只能靠数值搜索近似，尤其非线性动力学问题缺乏可解释的解析结构；现有加权和、进化算法等虽能给出近似前沿，却难以揭示其几何与守恒性质。作者希望利用Noether第二定理和规范对称性，把Pareto前沿刻画为问题对称群的不变量，从而为多准则优化提供严格的解析基础。
detailed_reading.method: 论文考虑一族在共同规范Lie群下不变的变分泛函，以Pareto最优性的加权Euler–Lagrange必要条件为核心，将规则Pareto点表示为加权泛函驻点；随后对局部规范对称性应用Noether第二定理，得到变分导数间的Bianchi型恒等式，并代入Pareto条件以约束Lagrange乘子、降低可行权重空间维数。基于该结构，作者导出两类可操作方案：通过规范固定进行降维，以及带罚项的可标量化求解；并在二准则LQR、带minimax准则的模型预测控制和带控制约束的双积分器三个经典问题上推导精确前沿方程并与数值结果对照。
detailed_reading.result: 理论结果表明，规则Pareto前沿包含于加权Euler–Lagrange方程解的并集，且在Pareto最优截面上Noether流的组合满足守恒；规范对称性通过Bianchi型恒等式进一步限制乘子权重，使可容许权重空间降维。三个算例中Pareto前沿均满足精确守恒律，可由问题对称性恢复前沿的解析结构，控制约束只限制可行集而不破坏底层守恒律；所提方法得到的前沿相对理论曲线偏差最小，优于已知多目标算法。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 论文建立了Noether第二定理与多准则变分问题Pareto前沿结构之间的严格联系，说明前沿的规则部分可由对称性和守恒律解析刻画，而不仅是数值近似结果。该工作为非线性动力学与控制中的多准则优化提供了新的解析处理框架，并表明规范函数或零Lagrange量可在动力学破坏对称性时帮助恢复不变量。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键假设包括泛函充分光滑、存在共同规范Lie群、讨论所有λ_i>0的规则Pareto部分，零权重边界点需另行分析；技术核心是高阶延拓生成元、Noether流与荷、Bianchi型恒等式及对Lagrange乘子的线性约束。实现层面强调规范固定降维与罚项标量化，并利用零Lagrangian改善数值收敛而不改变前沿解析结构；局限性在于解析结果主要适用于具有明显对称性的问题类别，非对称或非规则前沿仍需数值方法补充。

deep_dive.title: Regulating Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand Operators with Fixed and Adaptive Penalties: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
deep_dive.authors_text: Korbinian Kügler, Carolin Schmidt, Florian Dandl, Filipe Rodrigues
deep_dive.abstract: Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly controls pricing and rebalancing, and dynamic regulation as a Partially Observable Stochastic Game in which a regulator periodically adjusts region-specific penalties in closed loop. Operator and regulator policies are learned with graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning. In experiments with real-world Manhattan data, fixed surge pricing penalties reduce the share of travelers facing excessive prices from 22% to 1%. For regional service availability, dynamic regulation improves the regulator's reward by up to 15.6% over fixed penalties of equal mean intensity. The gains in service availability are strongest when spare fleet capacity exists, whereas service deficits persist in peak periods with highly utilized fleets. The learned regulator policy responds by reducing penalties where limited fleet capacity restricts compliance. The results identify trade-offs between regulatory targets, operator profitability, and traveler utility.
deep_dive.tldr: The paper uses graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning to learn fixed and adaptive penalty-based regulation of a profit-maximizing autonomous mobility-on-demand operator, showing that fixed surge-pricing penalties sharply reduce excessive prices while adaptive region-specific penalties improve service availability over equally intense fixed penalties, especially when spare fleet capacity exists.

detailed_reading.motivation: 利润最大化的自动驾驶按需出行（AMoD）运营商可能通过过高定价攫取消费者剩余，并将车辆从低利润区域调走来减少这些区域的服务。本文研究多模式交通系统中基于罚款的监管如何限制动态加价并改善区域服务可用性。现有工作要么学习没有外部激励的运营商策略，要么把监管视为固定工具并针对策略性或稳态响应评估，尚不清楚固定监管对学习型运营商的影响，以及闭环自适应激励的效果。
detailed_reading.method: 本文将监管建模为作用于学习型运营商的外层控制环：静态监管形式化为运营商在固定罚款下联合控制定价与再平衡的马尔可夫决策过程，动态监管形式化为部分可观测随机博弈，其中部分观测的监管者以较低决策频率周期性调整区域特定罚款并追求与运营商不同的目标。运营商状态包含路网邻接矩阵、时间、各区域空闲车辆、规划期内预期到达、排队长度、上一时步聚合需求与价格，以及服务可用性罚款和服务率或动态加价罚款和价格因子；动作为起点价格因子和期望空闲车辆份额，票价由参考票价与价格因子相乘并受两倍参考票价上界约束，期望空闲车辆份额通过最小成本优化转化为再平衡流。需求按泊松分布生成并以1.2倍历史需求缩放，出行者用二元Logit在AMoD与公共交通间选择，AMoD请求按先到先服务匹配，等待超过阈值则转向公共交通；运营商与监管者策略均用基于图的多智能体强化学习学习，监管者每隔若干运营商步更新一次罚款。
detailed_reading.result: 在曼哈顿真实数据实验中，固定动态加价罚款将面临过高价格的出行者比例从22%降至1%。对于区域服务可用性，动态监管相对等平均强度的固定罚款将监管者奖励最多提高15.6%。服务可用性收益在存在闲置车队容量时最强，而在车队高利用率的高峰时段服务赤字仍然存在；学习到的监管策略会在有限车队容量制约合规的区域降低罚款。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 固定罚款足以抑制过度动态加价，而闭环自适应罚款在改善区域服务可用性方面优于等强度固定罚款，说明监管工具应按目标区分设计。结果揭示了监管目标、运营商利润与出行者效用之间的权衡，并表明动态监管需考虑车队容量约束，不能完全消除高峰期的服务赤字。
detailed_reading.key_details: 数据与先验包括曼哈顿真实出租车需求、公共交通GTFS服务与历史参考票价；需求泊松缩放系数为1.2，价格上界系数为2，服务率按区域总出行需求而非仅选择AMoD的需求归一化，以避免运营商通过抬价抑制需求来“达标”。罚款与区域服务赤字或动态加价超额及罚款水平成比例，静态监管使用空间均匀固定罚款，动态监管使用区域特定且低频更新的罚款；运营商奖励为收入减运营成本再减罚款。实现上采用基于图的多智能体强化学习联合学习运营商定价/再平衡策略与监管者策略；局限性包括高峰高利用率下车队容量限制使服务赤字持续、动态加价未做动态监管评估（因固定罚款已几乎消除过度加价且罚款支付可忽略），且预览未给出具体损失函数与完整超参数。

deep_dive.title: A Survey of Nonlinear Filtering Methods for Data Assimilation and Recent Advances in Generative AI-Enabled Score Filters
deep_dive.abstract: Many real-world applications, such as numerical weather prediction or wildfire tracking, involve modeling highly nonlinear dynamical systems that are chaotic and influenced by various sources of uncertainty. To improve model prediction accuracy and reduce such uncertainties, data assimilation (DA) combines the dynamical model with partial, noisy observations to estimate the evolution of the system's state. Doing so depends on solving the optimal filtering problem: computing the conditional distribution of a hidden state given a sequence of observations. Classical approaches fail along three distinct axes: Kalman-based methods assume Gaussian posteriors and produce biased estimates under nonlinear observation operators; particle-based methods represent distributions with weighted samples and collapse in high dimensions due to the curse of dimensionality; and kernel-based methods move beyond discrete particle representations but cannot maintain their density approximation affordably as dimension grows. The Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) avoids all three constraints by encoding the filtering density in a score function and approximating that score with a training-free Monte Carlo estimator, enabling stable filtering in high-dimensional, chaotic systems. This survey traces EnSF's mathematical foundations, establishes it as the state of the art for non-Gaussian, high-dimensional filtering, and examines fourteen extensions that expand its operational reach. Twelve of the fourteen extensions preserve this training-free Monte Carlo estimator at the core of the update, with only two departing from it to achieve planetary-scale deployment.
deep_dive.tldr: This survey reviews classical nonlinear filtering methods for data assimilation, establishes the training-free Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) as state-of-the-art for non-Gaussian, high-dimensional filtering, and examines fourteen extensions that broaden its operational reach.

detailed_reading.motivation: 数值天气预报、野火追踪等应用依赖对高度非线性、混沌且受多源不确定性影响动力系统的状态估计，数据同化需在仅有部分含噪观测时求解最优滤波问题，即隐状态在观测序列下的条件分布。经典方法在三个轴上受限：Kalman类假设高斯后验并在非线性观测算子下产生偏差，粒子类在高维中因维数灾难而坍缩，核类虽脱离离散粒子表示但随维度增长无法廉价维持密度近似。因此需要同时兼顾非高斯表达力、高维可扩展性与可负担密度表示的新框架。
detailed_reading.method: 论文以状态空间模型和递归贝叶斯滤波为统一框架，先形式化预测的Chapman-Kolmogorov传播与以似然进行的贝叶斯更新，再按“如何表示与更新滤波密度”综述Kalman族、粒子滤波和BSDE/核方法，并引入score-based生成模型。核心EnSF不存储高斯参数或直接粒子，而将滤波密度编码为关于状态的log密度梯度score，用由该score引导的反向时间SDE生成后验样本；其score由闭式、免训练的Monte Carlo估计器近似，步间无需重新训练神经网络，随后按五个“幕”考察十四个扩展，覆盖算法改进、更难状态与预报问题、机制修改及放弃免训练特性以实现行星尺度部署。
detailed_reading.result: 综述给出结构性对比结论：Kalman族可扩展且密度表示廉价但完全牺牲非高斯表达力，粒子滤波可表达任意非高斯结构但所需样本随维度指数增长，核方法在维度增长时难以廉价维持密度近似；EnSF则被论证为非高斯高维滤波的最新水平，并可在约一百万状态维度的混沌系统中稳定滤波。十四个扩展中有十二个在更新核心保留免训练Monte Carlo score估计器，仅两个为达到行星尺度部署而偏离该核心。
detailed_reading.conclusion: EnSF通过把BSDE反向提取分布信息的思想与score生成模型的反向扩散过程结合，绕开经典方法在高斯性、维数灾难和密度表示成本之间的三角权衡，形成可操作的高维非高斯滤波框架。综述认为其数学基础与扩展生态已足以支撑从算法改进到业务尺度预报的多层次需求，但真正行星尺度部署可能需要修改甚至放弃其免训练核心。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现点包括非线性状态转移f与可能非线性观测算子g、高斯观测噪声及其协方差Σ、后验正比于先验乘高斯似然、score定义为∇log密度以及反向SDE采样；EnSF的闭式免训练Monte Carlo估计器避免逐步重训，是其高维稳定性的核心。综述还涉及粒子滤波的有效样本量ESS与M/2重采样阈值、EnKF的低秩样本协方差与虚假相关、LETKF的局地化半径人工超参和逐格点小特征问题、UKF的2d+1 sigma点及协方差矩阵操作成本。局限在于本文为综述而非统一基准实验，定量结论多来自所引工作；行星尺度扩展仅两个且牺牲免训练性，Kalman族仍受高斯假设与非线性偏差约束，粒子/核方法分别受维数灾难和密度近似成本约束。

deep_dive.title: Practical Semialgebraic Optimization via Sparse Sample-Based Sum-of-Squares Programming
deep_dive.abstract: As the importance of semialgebraic optimization grows in engineering, so does the need for scalable sum-of-squares (SOS) methods. Their convex relaxations can guide mixed-integer search and often deliver certified global optima outright. Scaling traditional SOS typically requires hand-crafted bases and redundant constraints, whereas sample-based SOS numerically exploits feasible set geometry to reduce bases and build smaller, often tighter relaxations from black-box evaluations. However, discrete variables can require exponentially many samples, and each sampled equation couples all cliques, destroying correlative sparsity. In this work, we avoid enumeration and slack variables by sampling a tractable variety that contains the feasible set, with multipliers only for the omitted constraints. To recover sparsity, we introduce "separator" polynomials that split the sampled equations into local systems coupled only on clique overlaps. This yields a novel, convergent hierarchy of semidefinite programs (SDPs) with block sizes and sample requirements governed by local interactions rather than total problem size. Lastly, we show how to verify sample sufficiency and prune redundant equations numerically before solving. In robust estimation and motion planning, we obtain certifiably small optimality gaps at scales far beyond those reported for traditional sparse SOS. For example, we solve a truncated least-squares 3D registration problem with 1600 candidate correspondences in under 49 seconds using an off-the-shelf SDP solver on a laptop CPU.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper introduces a sparse sample-based sum-of-squares hierarchy that samples a tractable variety containing the feasible set and uses separator polynomials to recover correlative sparsity, enabling scalable certified semialgebraic optimization without slack variables or discrete enumeration.

detailed_reading.motivation: 半代数优化在工程优化中日益重要，但传统平方和（SOS）方法扩展到大规模问题时通常依赖手工构造基和冗余约束；采样式 SOS 虽能利用可行集几何、降低基规模并得到更紧松弛，却受限于离散变量导致样本指数增长、采样方程全局耦合而破坏相关稀疏性，且难以直接处理大量不等式和可约问题。本文旨在不枚举离散赋值、不引入松弛变量的前提下，把采样式 SOS 扩展到一般稀疏半代数问题。
detailed_reading.method: 方法选择一个包含真实可行集的易处理代数簇，在其上随机采样，并以黑箱方式评估目标与约束；仅对省略的约束保留乘子，从而避免枚举和松弛变量。利用相关稀疏性引导团分解，并引入 separator 多项式把采样得到的证书方程拆成仅在团重叠处耦合的局部系统；再通过对局部单项式评估矩阵做 SVD 构造高效证书基与 separator 基，商掉冗余方向，组装成稀疏耦合的局部 SDP。求解前用秩检查验证样本充分性并剪除线性冗余方程，最后求解稀疏 SDP，并由对偶样本矩恢复原问题的全局最优解。
detailed_reading.result: 在鲁棒估计和运动规划任务上，该方法在远超传统稀疏 SOS 报道的规模下取得可验证的小最优性间隙，并自动产生比手工定制公式更小的 SDP。一个代表性结果是：对含 1600 个候选对应的截断最小二乘 3D 配准问题，在笔记本 CPU 上使用现成 SDP 求解器可在 49 秒内求解。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 该工作将采样式 SOS 的数值优势与传统 SOS 的直接适用性结合起来，使大规模可验证全局半代数优化可由黑箱评估而非逐问题代数工程实现。作者认为这为半代数优化提供了新的实用水平，并降低了对手工构造公式的依赖。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现包括：采样自包含可行集的易处理簇而非可行集本身；用 separator 多项式恢复相关稀疏性，使块规模和样本需求由局部交互而非总问题规模决定；用局部单项式评估矩阵的 SVD 构造证书/ separator 基，并通过秩检查与冗余方程剪枝保证样本充分性。该框架保持黑箱接口，适用于混合整数和不等式较多的问题，但其效果依赖所选取的易处理簇、相关稀疏结构及团分解质量，且求解前仍需数值验证样本充分性；结果以 SDP 松弛和可验证最优性间隙为核心，并未依赖传统训练损失或超参数调优。

deep_dive.title: A Night at the LLM Zoo: Data Conditioned Flow Matching for Generating Pretrained LLM Weights
deep_dive.authors_text: Scott Biggs, Bedionita Soro, Saumya Gupta, Bruno Andreis, Sung Ju Hwang
deep_dive.abstract: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. By demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held out mixtures, measuring Continuous Ranked Probability Score skill, as well as finding minimal changes in downstream test-set perplexity and general capability benchmark scores, we show that our generator generalizes on the simplex of data mixtures to produce models that perform similarly to those in the zoo ex nihilo. Finally, we produce all source code and artifacts to support the continued expansion of Weight Space Learning and Generation into the LLM domain.
deep_dive.tldr: The paper builds a curated GPT-2 model zoo across data mixtures and uses it to train a data-conditioned Flow Matching model that generates complete pretrained LLM weights from a desired training-mixture composition, generalizing to held-out mixtures and producing functionally comparable models from scratch.

detailed_reading.motivation: 将权重空间学习从特定任务和视觉模型扩展到大型语言模型时，关键障碍是缺少经过良好整理与分析的LLM模型群体。作者因此构建系统变化的GPT-2模型动物园，以支撑LLM权重的权重空间生成研究。
detailed_reading.method: 作者按网页文本、书籍、数学、代码和法语五类数据的不同混合组成，训练参数规模为51M、124M和355M的GPT-2模型群体，每个规模N=100，并用余弦相似度、功能多样性、留一混合建模和方差分解分析该动物园。随后将训练混合组成嵌入为条件，在Gram-PCA压缩后的完整预训练LLM权重空间中训练Flow Matching生成器，并通过对留出混合物的零样本泛化、CRPS技能评分以及下游测试困惑度和通用能力基准评估生成模型。
detailed_reading.result: 分析表明该动物园包含多样模型，且模型间变异由训练数据混合组成结构化。生成器能在数据混合单纯形上对留出混合实现零样本泛化，从零生成的模型在下游测试集困惑度和通用能力基准分数上仅有极小变化，表现与动物园中模型相似。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 该工作证明数据条件化的Flow Matching可在压缩权重空间中生成完整预训练LLM权重，并泛化到未见数据混合，为权重空间学习与生成进入LLM领域提供了模型动物园、方法框架和可复现资源。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现包括按五类数据混合比例系统构建三个GPT-2规模层级且每层100个模型，以混合组成作为生成条件，在Gram-PCA压缩权重空间上建模完整预训练权重，并用CRPS和下游困惑度/能力基准检验生成质量；局限在于模型规模限于较小GPT-2且数据混合维度与群体规模有限，结论主要覆盖该受控动物园范围。

deep_dive.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
deep_dive.abstract:
Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL).
  We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards.
  Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.
deep_dive.tldr: **TLDR:** Octopus is a single-model multi-agent RL framework that lets parallel LLM branches share one backbone by coordinating over a GPU-resident DAG of KV states via O(1) zero-copy forking, attention-only sibling-KV mounting, and a packed DAG-GRPO trainer, yielding substantially higher search accuracy and training/memory efficiency than flat single-agent or text-summary multi-agent RL baselines.

detailed_reading.motivation: 长程深度搜索与多跳推理天然是分支过程，需要并行子查询、放弃死路并交叉验证兄弟分支发现；但现有服务引擎、智能体框架和RL训练器把每个episode压成扁平追加文本序列，导致上下文窗口快速饱和、失败绕路污染注意力、原地编辑破坏前缀KV缓存与混合循环状态。多智能体框架还在分支间复制前缀KV并用文本摘要重新预填充交换结果，RL阶段又压平或丢弃跨分支依赖，因此需要一种共享主干、以GPU驻留KV DAG协调分支的单模型多智能体RL框架。
detailed_reading.method: Octopus把每个回合绑定到不可变GPU radix游标，通过fork、read_thread、wait_threads、rewind、commit五个原语在GPU驻留DAG上协调分支：fork以O(1)游标视图共享父前缀物理KV页并给子分支独立增长预算，rewind回滚死路并恢复混合循环检查点，read_thread零拷贝把兄弟线程终端KV块仅挂载到全注意力层，使用单调位置偏移且循环层跳过挂载span。训练端Packed DAG-GRPO将所有episode分支打包为一次块稀疏注意力前向，用前缀去重损失掩码和leave-one-branch-out边际奖励分配反事实分支信用。系统在Qwen3.5-4B上以纯二元结果奖励端到端GRPO训练，输入为稀疏BM25语料上的检索与推理轨迹。
detailed_reading.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus上达到49.6%准确率，较143K上下文单智能体GRPO提升17.5点、较文本摘要多智能体RL提升12.5点；在OpenResearcher上达到51.2%，超过至多250倍大的稠密检索智能体。Attention-Only KV Mounting把off-task hijacking从57.9%降至2.7%（21倍），在零额外KV分配下保留92.2% full-text mutual information。系统还将训练吞吐提升3.3倍、峰值KV内存降低2.8倍，并在每回合活跃提示约26.4K token下把探索上下文扩展到329.2K。
detailed_reading.conclusion: Octopus表明，把多智能体分支执行建模为共享主干上的GPU驻留KV DAG，并由RL端到端训练，可以在不复制前缀KV、不依赖文本摘要交换的情况下实现潜伏KV通信与集体扩展。该工作统一serving runtime、GPU内存管理与RL训练器，验证了混合循环-注意力模型上无劫持零拷贝KV挂载和DAG-GRPO的有效性。

quick_skim.title: Ramification of Weighted Central Paths and Super-linear Interior-Point Methods for Semi-definite Optimization
quick_skim.authors_text: Ali Mohammad-Nezhad, Pouya Sampourmahani, Tamas Terlaky
quick_skim.abstract:
The local convergence of primal-dual interior-point methods for semi-definite optimization is closely tied to the regularity of the central path at its limiting point. Without strict complementarity, the central path can exhibit fractional power asymptotics and need not be differentiable in the ordinary barrier parameter.
  We show that this obstruction can be removed simultaneously for a family of weighted \AHO~central paths. More precisely, there exists a common ramification exponent $N$ such that all weighted paths in a fixed neighborhood of the identity become analytic at the limiting point after the reparametrization $μ\mapstoμ^N$. Using higher-order derivatives of these reparametrized paths, we construct a feasible $p$th-order predictor-corrector interior-point method.
  Under a uniform predictor regularity condition, and without assuming strict complementarity, we prove that the normalized complementarity gaps converge with $Q$-order at least $(p+1)/ρ$, where $ρ$ is the reparametrization exponent used by the method. We also establish super-linear convergence of the simultaneously vanishing primal-dual blocks, derive an explicit quantitative reduction bound throughout the predictor regularity region, and obtain a doubly logarithmic outer iteration bound once the iterates enter the local super-linear regime. Finally, we illustrate the predicted higher-order behavior on a collection of degenerate and non-degenerate semi-definite optimization problems.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper proves that a family of weighted AHO central paths in semidefinite optimization becomes analytic at its limit after a common reparametrization, enabling higher-order predictor-corrector interior-point methods with superlinear/Q-order convergence even without strict complementarity.

quick_skim.title: How to Look Inside the Black Box: A Survey of Yu. E. Nesterov's Contributions (On the Award of the 2026 Gauss Prize)
quick_skim.authors_text: A. V. Gasnikov, A. Yu. Gornov, D. M. Dvinskikh, Yu. V. Dorn, D. I. Kamzolov, Yu. V. Maximov, V. V. Matyukhin, R. F. Hildebrand
quick_skim.abstract: On July 23, 2026, at the opening of the International Congress of Mathematicians in Philadelphia, the International Mathematical Union announced the award of the Gauss Prize to Yurii Evgenievich Nesterov -- an award for mathematical work with significant applications outside mathematics. This article explains the mathematical content of the recognized work of Yu. E. Nesterov and traces its influence on modern computational practice. The exposition is based on a concept that Yu. E. Nesterov himself regards as one of his main results: the classical complexity theory of convex optimization is oriented toward a black-box oracle, but its pessimistic bounds can be overcome by using a priori information about the internal structure of the objective function. We trace Yu. E. Nesterov's scientific career, then introduce the language of oracle complexity together with a classification of objective function models (geometric, algebraic, and structural), and subsequently discuss his main results in chronological order: the fast gradient method, fast automatic differentiation, the theory of self-concordant barriers and polynomial-time interior-point methods, the $π/2$ theorem, the stable dynamics model of traffic flows, the smoothing technique, primal-dual methods, cubic regularization of Newton's method, the modified Gauss--Newton scheme, coordinate descent methods and methods for huge-scale problems, gradient-free methods, universal gradient methods, implementable tensor methods, and "superfast" methods. Each topic is accompanied by historical background, precise statements specifying the problem class, oracle, and type of guarantee, examples, and a discussion of the current state of the art.
quick_skim.tldr: This survey reviews Yurii Nesterov’s Gauss Prize–recognized contributions to convex optimization, centering on how a priori structural information about objective functions can overcome pessimistic black-box oracle complexity bounds and tracing these ideas’ influence on modern computational practice.

quick_skim.title: Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games: Fundamental Limits and Regret Bounds via Temporal Approximation
quick_skim.authors_text: Yuval Dagan, Nadav Eisen, Liad Erez, Tomer Koren
quick_skim.abstract:
Optimistic Hedge, a multiplicative weight update with one step of extrapolation, is one of the most natural regret-minimizing dynamics for games, and characterizing its regret has been a longstanding open question. Daskalakis, Fishelson and Golowich proved that if all $m$ players in a finite general-sum game follow Optimistic Hedge with a fixed learning rate, each player's regret is polylogarithmic in the horizon $T$. Subsequently, Ha showed that an appropriate choice of learning rate makes each player's regret bounded independently of $T$. This bound, however, is non-constructive and its dependence on the number of actions $n$ is not explicit, leaving open whether Optimistic Hedge can achieve a constant regret bound which is polynomial in the size of the game.
  We show that the answer hinges on the number of players. In two-player games, there is a learning rate for which Optimistic Hedge guarantees $O(n\log n)$ regret independent of the horizon. In three-player games, however, no such bound is possible: for any learning rate up to an absolute constant and for sufficiently large horizon $T$, there is a game with $n$ actions per player in which some player's regret is $2^{Ω(n)}$, and more generally, for every $m\ge3$ we construct $m$-player games in which some player's regret is $2^{Ω(mn)}$; for learning rates above $2^{-Ω(mn)}$, that player's regret even grows linearly in $T$.
  Our upper bound is based on a temporal approximation framework for the analysis of Optimistic Hedge. Starting from the variance-based RVU bound of Daskalakis et al., we approximate the losses over time-localized windows by well-behaved functions, whose total variation is a small fraction of their cumulative variance. In $m$-player games, the same framework gives a significantly simplified proof of the recent $O(\sqrt{m}\log n\log T)$ regret bound due to Ha.
quick_skim.tldr: This paper shows that fixed-learning-rate Optimistic Hedge achieves horizon-independent \(O(n\log n)\) regret in two-player general-sum games, but for three or more players no game-size-polynomial horizon-independent bound is possible, with exponential-in-\(mn\) lower bounds, established via a new temporal approximation framework.

quick_skim.title: Scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification for Cancer Histopathology: Calibrated Uncertainty Under Distribution Shift
quick_skim.authors_text: Yunru Zheng, Wun Ting Chan, Sampras Dsouza, Zhenyu Hong
quick_skim.abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. We evaluate on two histopathology benchmarks for breast cancer metastasis detection: PCam and CAMELYON17-WILDS, where the latter tests calibration under hospital-level distribution shift. Compared to stochastic variational GP and neural network baselines, our method improves calibration and predictive performance - reducing expected calibration error by up to 88% and false negative rate by up to 90% - with the largest gains appearing under distribution shift, suggesting that HMC-based posterior sampling provides more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for cross-site pathology classification.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper proposes a scalable Bayesian Gaussian process classifier for cancer histopathology that combines accelerated RPCholesky low-rank factorization, HMC posterior sampling, and pivots-as-inducing-points on frozen Phikon embeddings to deliver better-calibrated and more accurate predictions under hospital-level distribution shift, reducing calibration error and false negatives relative to SVGP and neural baselines.

quick_skim.title: Curvature by Design: A Support Structure for Continuum Robots
quick_skim.authors_text: Justus Sagemüller, Harald Minde Hansen, Kristin Y. Pettersen
quick_skim.abstract: Constant- and piecewise-constant-curvature models are widely used to simplify the kinematics of continuum robots, although the assumed curvature profiles are not necessarily inherent mechanical properties of the robot and may therefore be violated during operation. Rather than assuming a prescribed curvature profile in the kinematic model and estimating deviations from it, this paper presents a multi-segment scissor-based support structure that mechanically constrains a continuum robot to exhibit prescribed constant or spatially varying curvature profiles. The design uses Taylor approximations to enable an overconstrained multi-joint linkage to predictably distribute global bending among the small-angle movements of multiple flexures. The geometric coupling is realized using compliant flexure joints, enabling the support structure to be manufactured as a single piece. The structure is integrated with a tendon-actuated continuum robot with a flexible backbone. Experiments show that the structure makes the robot resistant to deformations other than the prescribed curvature, significantly enhancing shape precision compared to classical flexible-backbone designs. This constrains the robot from making S-shapes when external loads are applied in the opposite direction of the bending. By mechanically constraining the admissible deformation, the proposed structure reduces the number of independent shape variables that must be estimated.
quick_skim.tldr: This paper presents a single-piece, scissor-based compliant support structure that mechanically constrains continuum robots to prescribed constant or spatially varying curvature profiles, improving shape precision and reducing the number of shape variables that must be estimated.

quick_skim.title: Uncertainty calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging
quick_skim.authors_text: Ismail Huseynov, Mohammad Orabe, Srikantan Nagarajan, Stefan Haufe
quick_skim.abstract: M/EEG source imaging requires accurate localization and reliable uncertainty estimates, yet posterior credible regions are rarely assessed for empirical calibration. We present a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration of empirical Bayesian inverse methods with closed-form conditional Gaussian posterior summaries. We compare Bayesian minimum norm (BMN) with sLORETA depth weighting and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) with sparse basis field expansions (S-FLEX). S-FLEX allows retained coefficients to contribute nonzero marginal posterior variance at locations where voxel-wise SBL yields degenerate variances. For BMN, we derive joint source- and noise-variance updates through evidence maximization. We test whether adaptive noise learning yields near-calibrated uncertainties. Both methods retain residual miscalibration, motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical coverage. Simulations assess fixed- and free-orientation models across signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), source sparsity levels, and subject-specific head models, using oracle, baseline-estimated, and adaptively learned noise. Before recalibration, SBL+S-FLEX yields lower Wasserstein localization error, smaller posterior uncertainty, and coverage closer to nominal credibility than BMN+sLORETA. Isotonic recalibration improves both methods, with larger gains for conservative BMN+sLORETA posteriors; transfer across mismatched SNR, sparsity, and head models remains condition dependent. Noise specifications yield broadly consistent reconstruction and uncertainty trends within each estimator. In real auditory MEG data, SBL+S-FLEX provides more focal localization and tighter uncertainties than BMN+sLORETA, suggesting greater statistical power for identifying bilateral auditory sources.
quick_skim.tldr: This paper presents a simulation-based framework for evaluating and recalibrating uncertainty in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging, showing that SBL with S-FLEX provides better localization, tighter posterior uncertainty, and closer-to-nominal coverage than BMN with sLORETA, while post-hoc isotonic recalibration further improves credible-region calibration.

quick_skim.title: Shaping & Monitoring Models through their Internal Representations
quick_skim.authors_text: Thomas Fel, Matthew Kowal, Matt Feiszli, Satchel Grant, Andrew Lee, Chris Earls, Fatih Dinc, Vasudev Shyam, Usha Bhalla, Leon Bergen, Siddharth Boppana, Ching Fang, Michael Byun, Tristan Gallent, Nicholas Wang, Tal Haklay, Dron Hazra, Neehar Kondapaneni, Connor Watts, Ryan Panwar, Thomas Dooms, Jack Merullo, Atticus Geiger, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Thomas McGrath, Owen Lewis
quick_skim.abstract: We propose Mechanistic Shaping, a unified framework for shaping models through their internal representations. Mechanistic Shaping is applied during training so that models follow specifications (rules) about which concepts they express, measured via their outputs or internal representations (e.g., no harmful content), and also which concepts they rely on, i.e., what they use to make their decisions (e.g., not a candidate's gender when screening a résumé). Across multiple domains (vision, medical imaging, language), scales (up to 32B parameters), and training paradigms (classification, SFT, DPO, GRPO), we find that Mechanistic Shaping substantially reduces targeted behaviors while preserving task performance. Since training against a representation can also modify it, we ask whether shaped concepts remain monitorable, a question that depends on the class of monitors considered. We therefore introduce a hierarchy of such classes, which separates a concept that escapes one probe from a concept that is truly gone. We characterize three geometric mechanisms of circumvention: the concept can drift away from the monitor, be erased from the layer, or persist in higher-order statistics as a nonlinear encoding, which we explain through a product-code construction. Although other mechanisms may arise in different settings or at larger scales, these three account for all of our observations, and each can be detected by a matching monitor. In practice, we find that shaped concepts largely remain monitorable: refitted linear probes recover the concept in most settings, and the original probe remains reliable whenever gradients do not flow through it. Taken together, these results point to the potential of using interpretability as a tool for training, and call for a correspondingly rigorous science of interpretability-based training.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper proposes **Mechanistic Shaping**, a unified framework that uses internal representations during training to control which concepts a model expresses or relies on—reducing targeted behaviors while preserving task performance and largely maintaining monitorability across domains, scales, and training paradigms.

quick_skim.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
quick_skim.authors_text: Teresa Delgado, Hugo Hazard, Martin Benfeghoul, Jun Wang, Zafeirios Fountas
quick_skim.abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.
quick_skim.tldr: LowRAM is a composable test-time KV-cache compression method that uses cross-layer low-rank key compression and amortizes values by learning a per-head key-to-value predictor with sparse residuals for poorly reconstructed tokens, enabling near-lossless 4× compression, up to 5× higher decode throughput, and up to 26.9× compression when combined with quantization and eviction.

quick_skim.title: Server-Side Sparse Assignment for Federated Mixture-of-Experts
quick_skim.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly recognized for their remarkable capabilities; federated learning (FL) offers a promising framework for collaboratively fine-tuning LLMs on edge devices while achieving data privacy. However, edge devices are inherently heterogeneous: clients may exhibit diverse data distributions and resource constraints, including limited memory and computation budgets. Recent federated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address these challenges by using sparse expert activation or partial expert loading. However, existing partial-expert methods rely on heuristic full-pool observations or prioritize system-wide load balance, without guarantees for recovering client-specific relevant experts from partial observations. We propose $S^3$-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments through an exploit--explore mechanism. We also establish relevance-estimation error and exact Top-$K$ recovery guarantees. Experiments using a CNN-based MoE on CIFAR-100 show that $S^3$-MoE recovers task-dependent client--expert preferences and reduces conflicts caused by correlated expert selection across clients. Compared with Full-20 FedAvg, which gives each client access to all 20 experts for local Top-5 routing, $S^3$-MoE achieves 1.31 percentage points higher mean final accuracy while loading only $5$ experts per client.
quick_skim.tldr: **TLDR:** The paper proposes \(S^3\)-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework for federated Mixture-of-Experts that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments via an exploit–explore mechanism, with theoretical recovery guarantees and improved accuracy under strict per-client expert-loading constraints.

quick_skim.title: Robust Stream Classification using Time Neutralising Decision Trees
quick_skim.abstract:
Data Streams are characterised as a potentially infinite source of data subject to non-stationarity. This non-stationarity, also called Concept Drift, often results in deployed predictive models having to be perpetually retrained as the underlying data generating process of the stream changes over time. Drift Detectors are a class of methods used to identify these changes, triggering these retraining procedures. Historically, Stream Learning has operated under the assumption that instances are only seen once, and cannot be stored for later use. Contemporary work relaxes this assumption, yet drift detection and simple resetting procedures are still ubiquitous.
  Building on related work which has shown that traditional Batch Learning algorithms often outperform Stream Learning algorithms when instances can be stored, we introduce Time Neutralising Trees (TNT), a Decision Tree architecture that enables robust stream classification in settings with Concept Drift. During training, TNT will filter out ("neutralise") old training samples that are no longer relevant given the current context of the stream. If those instances become relevant again, TNT will then re-include them. We evaluate TNT, and related algorithms on 24 real and semi-real classification data streams from the USP DS repository. Results show strong evidence that TNT achieves best-in-class performance on a wide-range of data streams with varying concept drift types.
quick_skim.tldr: TNT is a decision-tree architecture for robust data-stream classification under concept drift that dynamically filters out outdated training instances and re-includes them when relevant, achieving best-in-class performance across 24 benchmark streams without relying on explicit drift detectors.

quick_skim.title: Big Models, Small Gains: Frozen Forecasters as Classifiers on MONSTER
quick_skim.authors_text: Rishit Jain, Rishit Kar, Chetashri Bhadane, Nilesh Patil
quick_skim.abstract: Forecasting foundation models are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for time series classification, but it remains unclear whether their pretrained representations offer an advantage over strong classifiers that do not require pretraining. This raises an important question: do these representations provide useful information beyond what the model architecture alone can capture, particularly when labelled data are scarce? We present a controlled benchmarking of two forecasting models, Reverso and Chronos-Bolt, on six large datasets from the MONSTER benchmark, using 1%, 10%, and 100% of the available training labels. We compare their frozen representations against four established time series classification methods and random-weight versions of the same forecasting models. Our results show that pretraining improves classification accuracy over random-weight counterparts on five of the six datasets, with gains of up to 23 percentage points. However, the frozen representations do not reliably outperform the strongest non-pretrained baseline in any setting: they perform worse in 15 of 17 settings and tie in the remaining two. Further experiments show that restoring amplitude information recovers part of the performance gap, while fine-tuning and forecast-error features do not close it. These findings highlight the importance of strong task specific baselines and random weight controls when evaluating forecasting foundation models for classification. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rachet2006/frozen-forecasters-monster.
quick_skim.tldr: Frozen forecasting foundation models improve over random-weight controls on most MONSTER datasets but do not reliably outperform strong non-pretrained time series classifiers, even when labels are scarce.

quick_skim.title: Depth or Description? When a One-Step Latent Score Replaces Lookahead in Proactive Information Acquisition
quick_skim.abstract: A proactive agent must decide what to ask before it acts. Exact lookahead values combinations of questions but is expensive and leans on a fitted model; a one-step score is cheap but can miss them. Our main finding: the need for depth often lies in how the hidden cause is described. A one-step score on the label can be blind to an interaction among answers. A score on a suitable latent cause is not, and where that latent encodes the decision it replaces most of depth at a fraction of the search. Described differently, the same problem can defeat the score while exact values do not move, so keep the latent small and check it against exact values. Probabilities learned from one language model's answers do not carry to another unless planning allows for both; those read from tokens are worth only a few labels.
quick_skim.tldr: A cheap one-step score on a suitably chosen, small latent cause can replace most expensive lookahead in proactive information acquisition when that latent encodes the decision, but it must be validated against exact lookahead because how the hidden cause is described determines whether the shortcut works.

quick_skim.title: Machine Learning for Live-Birth Prediction After IVF/ICSI From Structured Clinical Data: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Critical Appraisal
quick_skim.authors_text: Abdul Raheem Shahzad, Muhammad Zaheer Khan, Umar Ajaib, Asad Ur Rehman, Juan Deng, Ming Zhang
quick_skim.abstract: Machine-learning models predicting live birth after in vitro fertilisation (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) from routine clinical data report performance from near chance to near perfect. We systematically reviewed these models under PRISMA 2020, searching OpenAlex, Scopus and Web of Science to 22 October 2026, appraised them with PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI, and pooled their discrimination with random-effects meta-analysis on the logit scale. We define what fixes the meaning of a model's output (decision point, endpoint, unit of analysis, data source) and map the 48 included studies by model family, decision point and validation design. Models evaluated only internally pooled to an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.814, against 0.756 (95% prediction interval 0.546-0.889) for models evaluated on a later period or another centre, and 0.764 for studies not at high risk of bias; neither difference was significant, and heterogeneity was extreme. Models whose decision point was not stated pooled to 0.910, the only significant moderator in meta-regression. Against logistic regression fitted to the same data, the best machine-learning model gained a pooled 0.056 AUC (95% CI 0.017-0.090). Of 48 studies, 47 were at high or unclear risk of bias, only four assessed the calibration slope, and no model has evidence of clinical impact. The certainty of the pooled evidence is low to very low; the gains that survive validation came from staging predictions to decision points and local calibration, not deeper architectures. We provide a TRIPOD+AI-mapped checklist, a benchmark specification and a research agenda.
quick_skim.tldr: **TLDR:** In a systematic review and meta-analysis of 48 studies, machine-learning models predicting live birth after IVF/ICSI from structured clinical data achieved pooled AUCs of 0.814 for internal validation and 0.756 for external/temporal validation—with extreme heterogeneity, mostly high/unclear risk of bias, low-to-very-low certainty, and no demonstrated clinical impact—and only modest gains over logistic regression (0.056 AUC) that came from aligning predictions with decision points and local calibration rather than deeper architectures.

quick_skim.title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
quick_skim.authors_text: Aleksandr Volkov, Roman Sultimov, Mikhail Kuzin, Yury Maximov
quick_skim.abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.
quick_skim.tldr: SteelAgent is an LLM-orchestrated, physics-informed system for steel property prediction, uncertainty reporting, and inverse design whose SteelBench audits show that random-split accuracy and nominal interval coverage can substantially overstate generalization to unseen steel families or sources, motivating property estimates to be reported together with their evaluation population.

quick_skim.title: Data-Driven Modeling of Molten Chloride Corrosion Using Static Test Data
quick_skim.abstract: Molten chloride corrosion has been studied for decades, yet reliable prediction across different alloys, salts, and test conditions remains difficult. In this work, 291 static molten chloride corrosion experiments reported in the literature were compiled into a structured dataset and used to develop an interpretable machine-learning framework for corrosion-rate predictions. To better represent the differences in salt condition across studies, a Chloride Salt Preparation Index (CSPI) was introduced to bring the reported salt-treatment method, atmosphere control, and pre-exposure impurity condition on a common numerical scale. A blended tree-based ensemble provided the most consistent predictive performance, achieving a cross-validated \(R^2\) of 0.85 and an MAE of 0.41 mg cm\(^{-2}\) day\(^{-1}\). The graded CSPI retained more useful information than a simple purified/unpurified classification and emerged as the dominant model descriptor. Global sensitivity and SHAP analyses further identified exposure time, temperature, and alloy chemistry as important contributors to the model predictions, with several observed trends consistent with the established molten-chloride corrosion behavior. The conformal prediction intervals were well calibrated, providing an estimate of prediction uncertainty in addition to the point prediction. Overall, the framework demonstrates that historical corrosion data can support quantitative, interpretable, and uncertainty-aware prediction when experimental context is represented explicitly, while also highlighting where more consistent reporting and targeted experiments are needed to improve future molten-salt corrosion models.
